caption: The drawing depicts a single statue of a standing female figure positioned on a rectangular pedestal base. The statue appears to be made of a material with a brownish-tan coloration, with greenish and lighter tan shading suggesting folds in the garments. The figure is dressed in layered clothing, including a long tunic with wide sleeves and a knee-length, pleated lower garment over trousers. The right hand is raised to the chest, while the left arm is relaxed by the side. The figure wears necklaces of large red beads and has dark red shoes. The figure’s hair is styled up in a bun, and the facial features are clearly defined. The background is plain and unadorned, allowing the focus to remain solely on the statue.
